_doc: THE FROZEN DEFAULTS every strategy inherits. Only the trade setup varies.
See docs/architecture/STRATEGY_WORKFLOW.md section 1.3.
ONE DOCUMENT, THREE CONSUMERS: the Python hunter/engine (via defaults.py),
the C# bot (generated into scripts/ninjatrader/shared/TradingDefaults.cs),
and the NT8 Strategy Analyzer (the nt8 block, cross-checked against
scripts/parity/backtest_profile.json). A value that appears in two of them
and disagrees is the drift this file exists to remove.
WHY IT EXISTS. Measured 2026-09-05, a single --ticker NQ1 run valued a point
at $20 in the P&L (core/backtest_engine.py's own table) and at $2 in the
prop-firm simulation (config point_value fallback). A 10x disagreement
inside one run, and the $20 figure contradicted ADR-009, which had already
decided micros. Three tables, two answers, nothing reconciling them.
DO NOT ADD A SECOND TABLE. tests/test_frozen_defaults.py scans for one.
A DATA TICKER AND A TRADED INSTRUMENT ARE DIFFERENT THINGS, and conflating
them is what produced the 10x error. `NQ1` names a PRICE SERIES (the
full-size continuous contract in data/NQ1_1m.parquet). `MNQ` names the
CONTRACT YOU TRADE. The prices are identical; only the multiplier differs.
So NQ1 price data traded as MNQ is correct and is the default here.
A PARTITION of the 24-hour day in America/New_York: contiguous,
non-overlapping, and covering every minute exactly once. Asserted by
test_the_session_windows_tile_the_day_exactly_once -- an overlapping set
would let one trade count in two sessions and make the breakdown sum to
more than the total.
SOURCE: nqstats.com/aln_sessions.html, the only session definition in this
repo carrying a source and a correction record (libs_py/nqstats/sessions.py,
GLOBEX / NY_LUNCH / NY_PM and NY_AM ending at 11:00 are the user's
decision of 2026-09-05; nqstats has no lunch split and ends NY_AM at 12:00.
Four OTHER session definitions exist in this repo and disagree with each
other -- config/sessions.yaml (RTH only), libs_py/data/session_tagger.py's
session_block, libs_py/ict_engine/core/sessions.py, and
context/compute_session_breakouts.py. This is the one to build on.
Sourced from config/sessions.yaml as it stood 2026-09-05 so this file
changes nothing on adoption; riskPerTradeFraction is derived from that
file's daily_max_loss / max_trades_per_day = 400/3 on a 50k account.
The subset that must match scripts/parity/backtest_profile.json.
requireGlobals are ASSERTED, never written: they are machine-global NT8
settings, and MergeBackAdjusted silently rescales every price.
